name: project_template
summary: Reusable phase and task blueprints with one-click instantiation
description: Standardise how repeatable projects start. Define a template as a blueprint of WBS phases and tasks with order, priority and estimated effort, then instantiate it to spin up a real draft project with the same phase and task structure automatically, preserving each task's phase. The template is never changed by instantiation so it stays a reusable standard, and a template without a task blueprint is blocked from producing an empty project.
author: Nexa
